purpose: Guarantee that scoreable reflection/still evidence uses the already-developed physical facade rough openings, world-aligned aperture UVs, deterministic apartment occupancy variation and physical glass-edge thickness, while preserving that exact prepared facade identity across Unity script/assembly reloads instead of silently accepting replacement roots as a fresh baseline.
formalPreparationOrder: sceneSaving-bound 4 mm glass perimeter edge construction
full pre-probe facade validation and scene persistence
freeze scene GUID plus stable GlobalObjectIds for optics/aperture/occupancy into UnityEditor.SessionState
registered material + physical UV + facade formal-build validation

reflectionLifecyclePolicy.newPreparationEpochIdentity: Clean Unity Editor session + benchmark scene GUID + authored/fallback mode + persisted GlobalObjectIds for generated optics/aperture/occupancy roots
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.firstPreProbeFingerprint: May build a genuinely missing generated pass, performs full source-side validation, requires persisted scene objects with stable GlobalObjectIds, then arms a SessionState epoch token.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.assemblyReload: The armed epoch survives script/domain reload through UnityEditor.SessionState. Reload is not permission to rebuild, replace or re-arm facade roots.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.subsequentEditorPolls: Must not write runtime reports or rebuild scene state. They verify scene GUID, authored/fallback mode, exact stable root identities, physical UVs, occupancy, glass thickness and report-free aperture construction state.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.inFlightMutation: Missing/replaced optics, aperture or occupancy roots, an authored/fallback mode switch, scene GUID drift or an unsaved replacement object is a hard failure; no automatic repair is permitted while reflection evidence may be in flight.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.resetBoundary: A clean Unity Editor restart is the conservative boundary for arming a fresh facade formal-build epoch.

requiredEvidence: hero/facade_center at 3840x2160 plus 100% review for repeated occupancy modules, opaque fallback intrusion and window construction seating
oblique/construction_depth at 3840x2160 plus 100% crop for 0.22 m RC rough-opening depth, perimeter seals, glazing/curtain ordering and light leaks
grazing/sash_rail_response at 3840x2160 plus 100% crop for physical UV scale, sash/seal/glass interfaces and non-painted grazing response
grazing/material_grazing and temporal pixels at 100% for concrete repetition, curtain/track LOD changes, thin glass-edge shimmer and reflection continuity
limitations: This binding proves only that the higher-fidelity source passes and the same persisted facade-root identities are present before and throughout formal reflection evidence; it does not prove their pixels are photorealistic.
Stable GlobalObjectId and SessionState checks are evidence-coherence controls, not visual scoring evidence.
Source-side geometry/metadata validation cannot clear obvious_repetition, major_light_leak, hero_geometry_intersection or any other visual critical defect without actual native render evidence.

Unity 6000.3.0f1 compilation, SessionState behavior, GlobalObjectId stability, scene serialization order, reflection-probe execution and 3840x2160 rendered output remain runtime verification pending until a Runner is available.
A clean Editor restart intentionally permits a new formal epoch; the external render-candidate freshness/provenance guards remain responsible for tying that epoch to the exact candidate revision.
Existing generated passes are validated rather than silently regenerated so evidence-state drift fails closed instead of being hidden during a formal packet.
